title: Address the Lab router
summary: Work out and configure IPv4 and IPv6 interface addresses, confirm them with routes, ping and ARP, see OSPF come up, and use a configuration group while a directly set value still wins. The logical systems lan-host and provider stand in for the LAN host and the Provider; do not change them.

stages.title: Address the LAN
stages.goal: Give the LAN port the first usable address of 192.0.2.0/26 and the IPv6 address 2001:db8:1::1/64 so the LAN host can be reached on both families. (Lessons 2.2, 2.3, 3.2, 3.4, 4.2, 4.3, 13.1, 13.2.)

stages.title: Address the provider link and the loopback
stages.goal: Address the provider link with the lower usable address of 192.0.2.252/30 and the loopback with 203.0.113.1/32, so OSPF to the Provider comes up and the Remote network answers. (Lessons 3.1, 13.2, 16.5.)

stages.title: Describe the interfaces with a group
stages.goal: Use a configuration group named LAN-DESC so ge-0/0/0 is described LAN side, while ge-0/0/1 keeps its own directly set description Provider link even though the group also applies to it. (Lessons 13.4, 13.5, 13.6.)
